architect.description: Deep architectural analysis and stage decomposition for a task, run by the architect role.

checkpoint.description: Saves a session-restore sentinel so a fresh session can pick up where the last one left off.
notes: Cleanup does not run before a checkpoint save; there is no cleanup skill in OpenCode.
The skill writes its own `recent-sessions.md` entry directly, without any automated background process.

rewrites.from: - Auto-fires as the first sub-step of `/cleanup` (default-on; `--no-cleanup` to suppress).

- Auto-cleanup: unless `--no-cleanup` is passed, invoke the cleanup skill as the
  first sub-step to trash stale sentinels before writing new ones.
rewrites.to: - Auto-cleanup is not available in OpenCode: there is no cleanup skill to invoke, so stale sentinels are left for the user to clear manually.

continue_work.description: Revives context from a prior session by presenting a session picker and the last checkpoint summary.
notes: There is no automated session index or Claude transcript in OpenCode.
Resume from the session-state file and the checkpoint handoff, never from a transcript.

rewrites.from:
- Session JSONL files for the sessions listed in `recent-sessions.md` (to extract last
  checkpoint summary and recent messages).
rewrites.to: - Session-state files under `{{ARTIFACT_ROOT}}/memory/sessions/` for the sessions listed in `recent-sessions.md` (to extract last checkpoint summary and recent messages).

rewrites.from:
- Tolerate missing JSONL: if a session JSONL file is missing, show a degraded summary
  from the session-state `.md` file instead.
rewrites.to: - Tolerate a missing session-state file: if one is missing, show a degraded summary from `recent-sessions.md` and the checkpoint handoff alone.

rewrites.from:
- Paths-not-content: reference session files by path; read only enough to extract
  checkpoint summaries and the last ~10 messages.
rewrites.to: - Paths-not-content: reference session files by path; read only enough to extract the checkpoint summaries, since there is no message transcript to sample.

critic.command_note: The coordinator delegates to the quoin-critic subagent through the task tool and persists the returned findings.
critic.description: Critiques a plan for gaps, risks and integration issues, run with no write and no shell access.
notes: The read-only subagent returns its findings as its final message; the calling role writes the artifact.
Tests run only in the calling role, never in the read-only subagent.
Running critic in this adapter is a separate context, not model diversity.

rewrites.to: (the calling role verifies the exact set with `quoin opencode script classify_critic_issues`, since the critic has no shell)

rewrites.from:
The runtime adapter is responsible for spawning a
  fresh agent; the mechanism is adapter-specific.
rewrites.to: The coordinator delegates to the quoin-critic subagent through the task tool, which OpenCode always starts with a fresh context.

discover.description: Scans every repo in the project and saves an inventory, architecture overview and dependency map.

end_of_task.description: Finalizes a reviewed task: commits remaining changes, pushes the branch and captures lessons learned.
notes: This skill is never started without an explicit user command.

gate.command_note: The coordinator repeats the failed-check rule when relaying gate results.
gate.description: Runs an automated quality gate and requires explicit human approval before the next phase.
notes: Run validators with quoin opencode script validate_artifact and quoin opencode script path_resolve.
A missing, failing or unrunnable validator is a failed check, never a reason to approve on judgment.
A validator warning that PyYAML is not installed means the frontmatter check did not run; report the result as partial, not as a pass.

rewrites.from:
Recovery: use the canonical safe reset-to-origin recipe at
  `memory/branch-recovery.md` (deployed Tier-1 memory file) — move
  mis-placed commits to a feature branch first, then run the recipe.
rewrites.to: Recovery: move the mis-placed commits onto a feature branch first, then reset the protected branch to match its upstream.

implement.description: Turns a converged plan into working code and tests, run by the implementer role.
notes: This skill is never started without an explicit user command.

rewrites.from: If task commits have already landed on a protected branch and need to be recovered, the canonical safe reset-to-origin recipe is at `memory/branch-recovery.md` (deployed Tier-1 memory file).
rewrites.to: If task commits have already landed on a protected branch and need to be recovered, move them onto a feature branch first, then reset the protected branch to match its upstream.

plan.description: Creates a detailed, implementation-ready plan for a development task, run by the planner role.

review.command_note: The coordinator delegates to the quoin-reviewer subagent through the task tool and persists the returned findings.
review.description: Verifies an implementation against the plan for quality, correctness and integration safety.
notes: The read-only subagent returns its findings as its final message; the calling role writes the artifact.
Tests run only in the calling role, never in the read-only subagent.
Running review in this adapter is a separate context, not model diversity.

rewrites.from:
include a pointer to the
  canonical safe reset-to-origin recovery recipe at `memory/branch-recovery.md`
  (deployed Tier-1 memory file).
rewrites.to: include a plain instruction: move the mis-placed commits onto a feature branch first, then reset the protected branch to match its upstream.

thorough_plan.description: Triages a task by size and orchestrates the matching plan-critic-revise convergence loop.
notes: The planner saves each critique the quoin-critic subagent returns as the critic-response file; the subagent never writes it itself.

rewrites.from:
The skill also spawns the gate skill (via the adapter's mechanism) after
convergence, and updates a session-state file under
`{{ARTIFACT_ROOT}}/memory/sessions/`.
rewrites.to:
After convergence, the user runs `/quoin-gate`, and the skill updates a session-state file under
`{{ARTIFACT_ROOT}}/memory/sessions/`.

rewrites.from:
- The skill MUST NOT produce plan content itself. It invokes the planning
  skill, the critic skill, and the revision skill as coordinated agents.
rewrites.to: - The skill MUST NOT produce plan content itself. The planner plans and revises in this session; each critique runs in a fresh quoin-critic subagent.

architect.description: Writes architecture artifacts for a task.
prompt: You are the Quoin architect. You produce the task's architecture document and stage decomposition, editing only inside {{ARTIFACT_ROOT}}.
You ask for approvals and choices in chat, because the question tool is denied to every Quoin role.

coordinator.description: Runs write-capable commands and persists findings returned by critic and reviewer subagents.
prompt: You are the Quoin coordinator. You run the review, critic, checkpoint, continue-work and end-of-task workflows, and you are the role that persists findings returned by the quoin-critic and quoin-reviewer subagents in the workflows you run; in plan and thorough-plan the planner saves critiques itself.
You ask for approvals and choices in chat, because the question tool is denied to every Quoin role.
Edits outside {{ARTIFACT_ROOT}} prompt for confirmation; prefer editing only inside it.

critic.description: Critiques a plan with no write and no shell access.
prompt: You are the Quoin critic. You cannot write files or run shell commands. You read the plan and the codebase and return your complete findings as your final message; you never write the critique artifact yourself.

gate.description: Runs deterministic validators and enforces the quality gate.
prompt: You are the Quoin gate. You run the deterministic validators named in your notes and report their results plainly; you cannot override missing evidence with judgment.
You ask for approvals and choices in chat, because the question tool is denied to every Quoin role.

implementer.description: Edits within the project to implement a converged plan.
prompt: You are the Quoin implementer. You edit source files anywhere in the project to turn a converged plan into working code and tests, but you never commit on a protected branch.
You never start implementation or finalize a task without an explicit user command.

investigator.description: Runs discovery and serves as a read-mostly delegation target.
prompt: You are the Quoin investigator. You scan repositories and write the discovery inventory, architecture overview and dependency map under {{ARTIFACT_ROOT}}.
You may run the helper scripts named in your permissions and edit only inside {{ARTIFACT_ROOT}}.

planner.description: Plans and revises in-loop for plan and thorough-plan.
prompt: You are the Quoin planner. You produce the implementation-ready plan and revise it against critic feedback in this same session, editing only inside {{ARTIFACT_ROOT}}.
You save each critique the quoin-critic subagent returns as the critic-response file before revising against it.
You run `quoin opencode script classify_critic_issues` on each saved critique to check its issue classes.

reviewer.description: Reviews an implementation with no write and no shell access.
prompt: You are the Quoin reviewer. You cannot write files or run shell commands. You read the implementation against the plan and return your complete findings as your final message; you never write the review artifact yourself.
